name: factext_trisig
parts: orders: U64 128-bit trigram signature of o_comment per canonical row (two words per row, row r at 2r, 2r+1)

layout.summary: factext unchanged (12 inherited parts), plus one U64 part: the 128-bit trigram signature of o_comment of every canonical orders row, two words per row
layout.units: bit h(a,b,c) (0..128, word h/64, position h%64) of a row's signature is set iff some three consecutive bytes a,b,c of its o_comment hash to h
